= camel cmd chaos-add

Add chaos rules to a running integration (camel-chaos, for development only)


== Usage

[source,bash]
----
camel cmd chaos-add [options]
----



== Options

[cols="2,5,1,2",options="header"]
|===
| Option | Description | Default | Type
| `--dry-run` | Check the rules without adding them: each in plain words, and what it would hit in the integration now (the sends, polls, routes or steps, with their route) |  | boolean
| `--rule` | A rule in its one-line text form, as an entry of camel.chaos.rules; can be given more than once |  | List
| `--timeout` | How long to wait for the integration to answer, in millis or as a duration such as 30s | 10000 | long
| `-h,--help` | Display this help and exit |  | boolean
|===
